features.label: Measured everything
features.detail: Dissected animals, catalogued constitutions, timed rhetoric. Philosophy as fieldwork rather than contemplation.

features.label: Virtue as a trained skill
features.detail: Not a rule you follow but a habit you are bad at first. Excellence is built, not chosen.

features.label: Tutored Alexander, and it failed
features.detail: The most famous student in history ignored the ethics entirely. Worth asking why.
